newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Far East airport to close for 36 hours.
newsitem.headline: Russian Far East airport to close for 36 hours.

text.p: Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk airport on Russia's Far East Sakhalin island will be closed for international and domestic flights on Tuesday for 36 hours for repairs to the runway, an aviation official said.

An official from the Moscow-based Aeronautical Information Centre said on Monday that flights to and from all destinations, including Japan, South Korea and China, would be cancelled at the airport from 0800 GMT on Tuesday to 2000 GMT on Wednesday.
